experiment.gate_transform: preferential QSNOW enhancement; positive-X linear quantiles; log interpolation with epsilon=1e-12; smoothstep u²(3−2u); alpha=1+2w in [1,3], with low-X alpha=1
experiment.vertical_application: one frozen 2-D alpha map applied at every native QSNOW mass level; float64 multiplication then native float32
experiment.matched_uniform_control: uniform alpha=gate diagnostic initial dry-mass-weighted QSNOW total/source total, using gravity=9.81 and ORIGINAL read_geometry dry_mass_kg; each staged rounded case must differ from its gate mass by <=1e-6 relative

cases.role: gated QSNOW; ORIGINAL executable and input
gated QSNOW; ORIGINAL executable and input
gated QSNOW; ORIGINAL executable and input
fixed executable crossed with ORIGINAL input; no QSNOW change
ORIGINAL executable crossed with B1 input; no QSNOW change

evaluation.weak_qualification_cells: all 18 CSI cells formed by 6 leads × thresholds {0.1,0.5,1.0} mm; candidate CSI must be >= baseline with zero tolerance
evaluation.strong_qualification_cell: lead-1 CSI at 10 mm must be strictly greater than baseline with zero tolerance
evaluation.candidate_admission: both weak and strong conditions are mandatory; if none qualify, report NO_QUALIFIED_CANDIDATE and do not relax rules
evaluation.eligible_new_cases: all eight completed identity-validated cases; crossed executable/input cases remain diagnostics and no single-process physical attribution is inferred
evaluation.new_history_pattern: runtime/cases/<CASE_ID>/wrfout_d01_2026-08-16_{12..18}:00:00; bound by each case receipt output_sha256

GATE_G50_90.transform: frozen G50_90 2-D alpha map applied to original QSNOW

EQ_G50_90.transform: uniform alpha mass-matched to rounded GATE_G50_90 initial diagnostic snow mass

GATE_G75_95.transform: frozen G75_95 2-D alpha map applied to original QSNOW

EQ_G75_95.transform: uniform alpha mass-matched to rounded GATE_G75_95 initial diagnostic snow mass

GATE_G90_99.transform: frozen G90_99 2-D alpha map applied to original QSNOW

EQ_G90_99.transform: uniform alpha mass-matched to rounded GATE_G90_99 initial diagnostic snow mass

evaluation.no_averaging: No averages across thresholds, leads, or experiments

interpretation_limits: Same-event diagnostic; no independent forecast-skill claim.
Gate and equal-mass fields alter only initial QSNOW; equal initial dry-mass-weighted QSNOW does not establish water, energy, or initialization conservation.
Crossed executable/input cases are a 2×2 diagnostic and do not isolate a single physical process.
Scoring uses total precipitation, not snowfall alone.
